mapper.sql: with enccac as( SELECT collection_accounts_bank as bank_org_id, ebank_serial_number as ebank_batch_no, system_code, business_ebank_number as ebank_serial_number, business_happen_date as account_date, account_age_class FROM ( SELECT collection_accounts_bank, ebank_serial_number, system_code, business_ebank_number, business_happen_date, account_age_class, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collection_accounts_bank,ebank_serial_number ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn FROM eg_non_confirm_collection_account_checking enccac where enccac.del_flag='0' ) AS subquery WHERE rn = 1 )
mapper.select:
select etopd.id, etopd.reclassification_month, etopd.bank_org_id, -- etopd.system_code, -- etopd.ebank_serial_number, -- etopd.ebank_batch_no, etopd.financial_primary_classic, etopd.confirm_account_property, etopd.reclassification_amount, etopd.account_code, etopd.account_name, -- etopd.account_date, -- etopd.account_age, -- etopd.account_age_class, -- etopd.pay_client_name, etopd.process_status, etopd.process_instance_id, etopd.is_generate_voucher, etopd.voucher_id, etopd.error_info, etopd.del_flag, etopd.create_by, etopd.create_time, etopd.update_by, etopd.update_time, etopd.ta_other_payable_id,
enccac.system_code system_code, enccac.ebank_serial_number ebank_serial_number, enccac.business_happen_date account_date, enccac.account_age_class, enccac.account_age, enccac.business_ebank_number ebank_batch_no, enccs.client_name pay_client_name from eg_ta_other_payable_detail etopd left join eg_non_confirm_collection_account_checking enccac on etopd.bank_org_id = enccac.collection_accounts_bank_code and etopd.ebank_batch_no = enccac.ebank_serial_number left join eg_non_confirm_collection_sum enccs on etopd.ebank_batch_no = enccs.ebank_serial_number where ta_other_payable_id = #{taId}
